newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina Mar fiscal deficit $447 mln, Q1 $1 bln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina Mar fiscal deficit $447 mln, Q1 $1 bln.

text.p: Argentina ran up a fiscal deficit of $447 million in March, taking its first total quarter deficit to $1.01 billion, the Economy Ministry said Friday.
The first quarter figure compared with a target agreed with the International Monetary Fund of $1.04 billion.
In March 1996, the fiscal deficit was around $430 million, according to consultants Broda y Asociados.

Taking into account payments to public sector workers due to government reorganization and the cost of taking on provincial pension funds, the overall March deficit was $538 million and the first quarter shortfall $1.34 billion.
The IMF agreed a target of $1.64 billion for this overall first quarter deficit.
The annual IMF targets are for a basic deficit of $3 billion and an overall deficit of $4.5 billion.
Private analysts doubt the government will achieve these goals.
